Updating a Registered Quirk.text: When a registered Quirk changes, its owner must update the registry, and failing to do so is an offense. An update is required when a Quirk gains a new function, grows clearly stronger or wider in reach, develops a new risk or drawback, or turns out to work differently than recorded; a late-appearing Quirk is registered for the first time the same way. The owner visits a licensed Quirk counselor or doctor, who tests the change and files the revision with the municipal office, and the record keeps both the old entry and the new one. Licensed heroes must also report changes to the Hero Public Safety Commission and their agency, and hero academies file updates for students whose Quirks grow during training. Ordinary growth from practice needs no paperwork. Missing an update brings a fine, and a capability used in a crime that was never registered makes the charge more serious. Updates are routine, and counselors see many each month.
